name: How do I choose the right size and BTU output for my linear fire feature?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right size and BTU output for my linear fire feature?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right size and BTU output depends on the intended use and the size of your outdoor space. For ambient lighting and a focal point in a smaller area, a shorter burner with lower BTUs may suffice. For significant warmth and a grander statement in a larger space, a longer burner with higher BTUs is appropriate. Consider the feature's placement within your overall landscape design and consult with a professional to ensure it meets your aesthetic and functional needs while complying with safety standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select size and BTU output based on your outdoor space, desired warmth, and aesthetic goals. Consult a professional for optimal choice.
